action_coverage.source: User-supplied full scan of this run's prepared physical trajectories, provided in this conversation on 2026-10-04. Counts copied from that scan; the full tensor cache was not rescanned for this documentation update.
action_coverage.candidate_scope: All stored turns, including terminal turns; before numbering augmentation. Chosen counts are unique physical demonstration actions.

documentation_scope: Completed-shard snapshots from the two containers sharing this run root (172.16.78.10:41467 and :35016), deduplicated by shard path. Not a live monitor. Missing or incomplete results are not zero.

snapshot.deduplication: Both hosts share one run root; each completed shard path counted once.

metric_notes.denominators: Stored raw summaries use: control / all turns; actions and ranking / all decision turns; stop and summary / terminal turns; pairwise and current / recorded pair counts; rollout / case variants. Reachability is the exception: the summary also computes action_keeps_goal_reachable_rate and reachable_candidate_rate over the current-reachable subset and records its size as solvable_decisions, so the two need no separate audit. Primary reference tables use that same subset, as defined in primary_reporting.
metric_notes.source: Counts recomputed from each completed shard cases.jsonl by src/collect_evidence.py through trajectory_eval.aggregate, the same function the queue uses to write the shard summary.json; the reachability audit is read off those same turns. No model inference or environment replay was run for this update.
metric_notes.uniform_baseline: For each scored decision turn, r/k = reachable_candidates/candidate_slots. Average these fractions across the same turns used for the model. The stored reachable_candidate_rate is instead sum(r)/sum(k) over that same subset, a candidate-slot-weighted proportion, so it is not the per-turn average.
metric_notes.current_reachable: remaining_shortest >= 1 on nonterminal turns. Already unreachable reference states score false independently of the model choice. Report this subset separately when judging whether the chosen action destroys reachability.
metric_notes.missing_reachability: Use reachability_audit.reachability_scored_turns to check field coverage; aggregate counts can contain implicit zeros for absent fields. Do not publish a full-battery rate when coverage is incomplete.
metric_notes.action_macro: Emitted by trajectory_eval.aggregate as a per-unit mean with a bootstrap interval; its unit and turn set are its own, so it is not the number in the report tables, whose denominators are in primary_reporting.
metric_notes.rounding: Displayed percentages use one decimal; 100.0% may be rounded. Integer counts are authoritative.

primary_reporting.rollout_shortest: reached_shortest / attempts; reached_goal and moves == shortest_moves, irrespective of stop output. Read from the same saved cases as the snapshot; shortest_success retains its original, stricter correct-stop meaning.
primary_reporting.reference_reachable: action_keeps_goal_reachable / current_reachable_turns; primary denominator is nonterminal turns with remaining_shortest >= 1.
primary_reporting.reference_shortest: action_environment_shortest / current_reachable_turns; any chosen action with successor distance equal to current distance minus one qualifies. Existing scorer rejects already-unreachable turns, so the original numerator is unchanged.
primary_reporting.secondary: Map-minimum action agreement and matched no_map/goal interventions assess map use separately. Full rankings, candidate sets, control and summaries are auxiliary diagnostics.
